references.text: Herod sends Jesus back to Galilee, which mirrors Jesus' family returning to Galilee after fulfilling the requirements of the law.
Moses instructs the Israelites to follow the Lord's laws and statutes, paralleling Jesus' family following the law by performing the rites.
The prophecy that a great light will shine in Galilee, which can be seen as a foreshadowing of Jesus' ministry there.
Joseph and Mary take Jesus to Nazareth in Galilee, which directly corresponds to the event in Luke.
